Find the next Canthan warrior trainer.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Warrior
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Look for Weng Gha in Panjiang Peninsula.

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Travel southwest until you reach [[Tsumei Village]]. Enter, and exit to the south. Weng Gha is close by, westwards.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Talon Silverwing
''Your skill is impressive for a human, though it will be years before you achieve Headmaster Zhan's level of expertise. It is time that you seek out [[Weng Gha]]. Due to his extreme dislike for my kind, there is little love lost between us, but his talent as a Warrior is unquestionable. Look for him in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will look for Weng Gha.
| decline = I will seek him out later.
| ask = [[Weng Gha]] is your instructor, now. Look for him in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Weng Gha
''Talon Silverwing set you? That Tengu is not half the Warrior I am, but then, no Tengu is. Why the general keeps him around is beyond me. If I had my way I would have cut him to pieces years ago. You can forget everything the Tengu taught you. Your real training will begin here with me.''
